name: U-LEAM Inc.
summary: U-LEAM Inc. manufactures and sells connectors, cable assemblies, interconnect systems, PCBs, circuitry, high-frequency components, and mechanical structures. It provides interconnect, internal and external cables for aerospace and SatCom; push-pull interconnect and pogo magnetic; outdoor waterproof interconnect for robust/harsh environment; USB Type C, HDMI, dongle, and hub and adaptors, as well as fleet asset management, ELD tracking, and monitoring solutions. The company also offers industrial design, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, and validation services.
